cases.description: Teardown during live background activity (runtime plugin): 20 reloads requested from inside a selection dispatch while a job is blocked on an exe-owned barrier, the file watcher is delivering, serial bytes stream in over the fake transport and selection/log/hotkey/EventBus listeners fire every frame (then a quiescence window keeps every path firing); 10 WM_CLOSE-while-job-blocked closes (2 s bar); 10 careless-plugin unloads (job released only after detach; the engine must not let the worker run into freed code); 10 real CS_MODULE load/unload/load/unload cycles hosted by PlayerLayer with the registry asserted clean after each unload. Each child asserts ordering, no invocation into unloaded code, listener-removed-mid-dispatch never fires, owned resources balanced and scenario threads back to the warmed baseline.
